data.description: You've trained under the philosophy that performances enhanced by magic are best when the magical enhancement itself is not obvious. When you activate a wand (or any similar spell trigger item that's relatively easy to conceal), you may make a Bluff check (opposed by the Perception check of any creature able to see you) to conceal the use of the item.
data.name: Hidden Wand
